description: Read n real values at a path, exactly as they were parsed (int64 and decimal digits intact). A path that selects one container samples its children; a path that selects many nodes samples those nodes. Pass filePath for a one-call sample, or docId to reuse an open document.

filePath.description: File to open and sample now instead of supplying docId.

n.description: How many values to return (default 5, max 50).

path.description: A query selecting what to sample, e.g. $.tasks or $.tasks[*].id

name: sample
